title: Sahasam
desc: Gautham, a security guard, comes across his grandfather's diary that takes him on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, Sultan, a terrorist, holds a Pakistani archaeologist hostage to find a treasure.

title: Pattam Pole
desc: Karthi and Riya, from two different religions, fall in love. Fearing their parents' disapproval of their inter-religious relationship, they elope to Ooty but return after a heated argument.

title: Koushalam
desc: Gopinadhan and Mathunni steal money from the rich and distribute it amongst the needy. When Mathunni robs Maya, Gopinadhan returns it and falls in love with her.

title: Bharathchandran I.P.S.
desc: Hyder Ali Hassan, a scheming politician, is in league with the underworld and runs a lot of illegal businesses. Balachandran, an IPS officer, is sent on a mission to capture him.

desc: The host reveals the ticket numbers and announces the names of the people from the state of Kerala who have won the lottery.

title: Ishq
desc: Sachi and his girlfriend, Vasudha, go on a date to celebrate her birthday. Things go sideways, and their love is tested when they are harassed by two men on a late-night drive.

title: Amma Ammaayiyamma
desc: Prabhavathy, one of five children, marries a rich businessman, Shekharankutty, and forgets about her family. Her husband decides to make her understand the importance of her family.
